title: 013 阴魂不散014 灶神眼
content_zh:
“矗隆”
一声猛烈的轰鸣炸响！
浓烟翻滚中疾驰的摩托车前轮狠狠一震，后轮近乎在巨大的冲击力下掀起。
车灯在冲击中爆开道道裂纹，前胎擦着地面疯狂摩擦，发出刺耳的撕扯声。
泥地被犁出了两道深深的沟壑！
这是超凡力量与超凡力量的正面碰撞！
裹挟着浓烟与火光的超凡摩托，竟被鬼影覆体的老者以身躯硬生生撞停。
但老者也并不好受！
碰撞的刹那，他整个人向后踉跄暴退十多步，覆盖周身的漆黑鬼影竟有一大半被震得几乎脱离躯壳，扭曲晃动着几欲溃散。
失去鬼影支撑，他双脚更是陡然如沙土般崩裂，“噗”
地炸开，化作一片飞溅的灰土，扬散一地。
这是【土地】的序列力量仍在生效！
若非那泥沼般的束缚残存于老者体内，持续侵蚀着他的行动与**。
单凭许临东驾驭摩托这一撞，整体的超凡力量，根本不足以伤到这老鬼。
可现在，老者却实打实吃了亏！
被撞离体的鬼影挣扎着想缩回身躯，却如同陷入泥潭，被那股黏浊的土地之力层层覆盖、拖拽。
“不！”
老者口中发出痛苦而浑浊的嘶吼，眼耳口鼻间溢出青黑色的污浊气息。
序列超凡物质的反噬，已经开始了！
他的身躯顿时在土地的侵蚀与自身超凡物质冲突的双重绞杀下，剧烈颤抖，情况急转直下。

“机会！”
许临东见状，毫不犹豫调动超凡力量。
他的胃腑如熔炉般灼烧发光。
抬手之间，熊熊灶火已自掌心轰然腾起。
轰！
一道炽烈火舌如怒龙出闸，自他掌中喷涌而出，瞬间将老头吞没。
下一刻，他取出上衣口袋的烟盒甩开。
嗖！
一根特制的灶烟划过一道弧线，叼在他的嘴中，被灶火点燃。
“嘶！
！”
他猛吸一口灶烟，旋即向老者喷吐而出。
一股烟气离口便化作了烟圈，迎风即涨，急剧扩大，仿佛一道无形结界罩向老者。
呼呼呼！
content_en:
"Chu Long"
There was a violent roar!
The front wheel of the motorcycle speeding through the billowing smoke was violently shaken, and the rear wheel was almost lifted off by the huge impact.
The headlights burst into cracks during the impact, and the front tires rubbed wildly against the ground, making a harsh tearing sound.
Two deep ravines were plowed into the mud!
This is a head-on collision between extraordinary power and extraordinary power!
The extraordinary motorcycle, engulfed in thick smoke and fire, was suddenly stopped by the ghostly old man's body.
But the old man didn’t feel well either!
At the moment of the collision, he staggered back more than ten steps, and more than half of the dark ghosts covering his body were shaken almost out of his body, twisting and shaking on the verge of collapsing.
Without the support of the ghost, his feet suddenly collapsed like sand, "poof"
The ground exploded and turned into a splash of dust, scattering all over the ground.
This is the sequence power of [Land] still in effect!
If it weren't for the quagmire-like restraint remaining in the old man's body, continuing to corrode his movements and desires.
Xu Lindong's collision with the motorcycle and his overall extraordinary strength alone were not enough to hurt this old ghost.
But now, the old man has really suffered a loss!
The ghost that was knocked out of the body struggled to retract its body, but it seemed to be trapped in a quagmire, covered and dragged layer by layer by the power of the sticky earth.
"No!"
The old man let out a painful and turbid roar, and a green-black filthy breath escaped from his eyes, ears, mouth and nose.
The backlash of extraordinary substances has begun!
His body suddenly trembled violently under the double stranglehold of the erosion of the land and the conflict with his own extraordinary material, and the situation took a turn for the worse.
"Opportunity!"
Seeing this, Xu Lindong did not hesitate to mobilize his extraordinary power.
His stomach burned and glowed like a furnace.
As soon as he raised his hand, a raging stove fire burst into flames from his palm.
boom!
A blazing tongue of fire spurted out from his palm like an angry dragon, instantly engulfing the old man.
The next moment, he took out the cigarette case from his coat pocket and threw it away.
Whoosh!
A special stove smoke drew an arc, was held in his mouth, and was lit by the stove fire.
"Hiss!
! "
He took a deep breath of stove smoke and immediately blew it out towards the old man.
A puff of smoke turned into a smoke ring as soon as it left the mouth, rising in the wind and expanding rapidly, as if an invisible barrier was covering the old man.
Hoo ho ho!
